result.evidence_quote: We investigated (1) whether the factor structure of prolonged grief disorder (PGD) and well-being remains stable over time, and (2) whether aspects of CJS involvement are related to latent PGD and well-being levels reported after the criminal trial.
result.rationale: The study examines grief, psychological well-being, and criminal justice involvement in bereaved people. It does not investigate brain or neural mechanisms, cognition, neurological disease, neural injury, or neurological treatments or biomarkers.
